turns.query: Identify the air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025. What was the average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact same time (rounded to 1 decimal place)?
turns.actual_response:
The air quality monitoring station that recorded the highest PM10 concentration at 14:00:00 on October 5, 2025 was the Causeway Bay station, with a PM10 concentration of 35.7 µg/m³.

The average recorded traffic speed across all road segments within 500 meters of this station at that exact same time was **53.3 km/h** (rounded to 1 decimal place).

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query PM10 concentrations at 2025-10-05 14:00:00 to find the station with highest PM10
query = text("""
SELECT station_id, pm10
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
ORDER BY pm10 DESC
LIMIT 1
""")
df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(df)

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Find average traffic speed within 500m of station 17 at 2025-10-05 14:00:00
query = text("""
SELECT AVG(hrst.speed) as avg_speed
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrst
JOIN road_segment rs ON hrst.road_segment_id = rs.id
WHERE hrst.datetime = '2025-10-05 14:00:00'
AND ST_DWithin(
    rs.geometry::geography,
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(114.18509, 22.280133), 4326)::geography,
    500
)
""")
result = pd.read_sql(query, engine)
print(result)
